issue.title: Pointer quick-pick menus on record sheet chips

task_type_fields.proposal: Clicking a choices chip on the in-note record sheet opens a small anchored pick menu (bob's labels and emoji, current value ringed) that applies the pick through the same guarded bob records update -i envelope with expect and Undo, instead of opening the full Record Card.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/record_card.md lists pointer quick-pick menus on sheet chips as out of scope; v1 routes every chip click to the Record Card stage.

issue.creation_reason: The Record Card epic (bob-cli-ms) deferred pointer quick-pick menus on sheet chips and asked its land agent to file it.
